transcript.user: what does emergency fund mean? what is liquidity? explain like im 5
transcript.content:
An emergency fund is money you set aside just for surprises, like a sick day, a broken phone, or losing your job. You keep it somewhere you can get to fast, so you never have to borrow at a high interest rate when something goes wrong. Think of it as a rainy-day jar.

Liquidity means how fast you can turn something into cash without losing much value. Cash is very liquid. A house is not, because selling takes months.
